_document.title: Rujira analytics: proposed GraphQL query structure
_document.purpose: Frontend query structure and response shapes; not executable SDL or sample data.

analytics.products: Financial metrics for Swap, Trade, AMM, VS and Money Market.

analytics.account: Weighted positive returns with category coverage, plus a separate debt-weighted borrowing APR.

views.history: Time series: range selects the dates; resolution sets each point's period, such as a day, week, month or year.
views.summary: One result for the selected range, including period totals and applicable statistics. Category breakdowns, such as volumeByToken, are queried separately; each field states its time scope.

_readingGuide.notation: Ordinary keys are fields; _keys are documentation. Each _note describes its containing field or category.
_readingGuide.returns: _returns names the response type; nested fields describe the object or each list item.
_readingGuide.arguments: _args lists argument types/defaults. _values lists allowed options, or previews fields within an input object. [] means list; ! means non-null. Required inputs without defaults must be supplied.
_readingGuide.conditionalOptions: _valuesBy* and _defaultBy* depend on the named argument.
_readingGuide.sharedDefinitions: _inputs defines reusable arguments; _types defines reusable responses; _enums lists named options.
_readingGuide.units: RATIO 0.25 = 25%. BPS 100 = 1%. currency selects the currency for original and moving average values. Absolute growth keeps units; relative growth returns RATIO.
_readingGuide.contextualUnits: CONTEXTUAL uses the containing field's _valueUnit (value) or _amountUnit (amount).
_readingGuide.missingData: Metric null = unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Other null meanings are noted on their fields.
_readingGuide.transforms: Optional transform: SMA (simple moving average), GROWTH, or retention-only COHORT_WEIGHTED_MA. _allowedKinds lists supported choices; omit transform for the original metric value.
_readingGuide.movingAverages: Smoothing can use history before the selected range. SMA weights points equally; COHORT_WEIGHTED_MA weights by the earlier user population.
_readingGuide.rateAverages: averageOver averages completed daily APR/APY observations with equal weights; known 0% counts. Trailing ranges end at the latest completed UTC midnight; explicit ranges use fully included, completed days. allTime uses full available daily history. Missing required observations or no observations returns null.
_readingGuide.chartHeadlines: Period totals: summary. Cumulative headlines: latest raw cumulative history value. Moving-average headlines: latest matching SMA value.
_readingGuide.periodTotals: Volume, revenue and transaction totals cover raw values in the selected range, independent of chart resolution or smoothing.
_readingGuide.series: Complete points use the last millisecond of their UTC calendar period; unfinished or range-clipped points use the last included measurement time.
_readingGuide.completeness: isComplete is true only when the full calendar period is included and has ended. Unfinished and range-clipped edge points are false; data may still be corrected.
_readingGuide.retention: Two consecutive 30-day windows ending at the period-end boundary, or timestamp if unfinished; summary uses its range-end cutoff. The recent window includes the closing day.
_readingGuide.filters: Filters inherit unless a field says otherwise. Empty-result behavior is documented per field.
_readingGuide.scalars: Decimal = exact unscaled decimal string in the stated unit, e.g. "12.50" USD means $12.50. Bigint = exact base-10 integer string in atomic token units where explicitly stated; divide by 10^token.decimals for token amounts. Timestamp = UTC date-time; Address = blockchain address.
_readingGuide.signedValues: Flows/waterfalls: deposits +, withdrawals -. Position withdrawn/claimedYield are positive payout totals. VS debt is positive; VS interest paid is negative. Waterfall balances/subtotals use TOTAL.
_readingGuide.pagination: Paginated tables return nodes + pageInfo; tiers and breakdowns return lists. Table windows are selected separately from the chart's date range.
_readingGuide.strategyTypes: Stable type IDs include CCL, DCL, BRUNE, VS and future types. BRUNE is the bRUNE/RUNE AMM on FIN.
_readingGuide.revenueRecipients: RUJIRA = allocation before downstream distributions, including the Ecosystem Fund; not actual staker payouts.
_readingGuide.balanceTiming: Balances use timestamp. Period totals cover the chart period; cumulative metrics include their documented history through timestamp.
_readingGuide.periodAlignment: UTC days start at midnight, weeks on Monday, months on the first day, and years on January 1. Complete years close December 31 at 23:59:59.999 UTC. Clip edge periods to the range with isComplete false.
_readingGuide.tokenDetails: Token.chain identifies the underlying token's chain. Token.variants identifies its Layer 1, secured and native bank representations; each representation states its own decimals. Token.price is a USD display price. Ghost Credit risk calculations use the separately identified oraclePrice.
_readingGuide.personalStakingValues: stakedValueUsd(mode) is stake-only. valueUsd(YIELDING) adds personal unclaimed rewards; valueUsd(AUTO_COMPOUNDING) is the underlying redemption value; TOTAL sums both. Receipt shares and retained compounded rewards are counted once.

weightedApr._note: Current USD-value-weighted positive return: AMM Total Profit APRs, staking APRs/APYs and lending APRs, with category coverage; borrowing costs are separate.

categories._note: Omitted/null includes all supported categories; [] selects none; duplicates count once. Future categories can join this aggregate.

weightedApr._rule: AMM: open CCL/DCL positions with positive total remaining USD value; use lifetime Total Profit APRs and principalValueUsd weights. STAKING: RUJI, BRUNE and TCY through Rujira, separately by token/mode. Count each position once; bRUNE stake does not also count underlying protocol AMM liquidity. Coverage includes only selected categories. Auto-compounding stake value includes retained compounded rewards; its rate is APY. LENDING: positive lender balances including accrued lender interest; current net lending APRs and balance-USD weights. No $1 threshold. Borrowing costs are excluded.

apr._note: USD-value-weighted blend of AMM Total Profit APRs, staking APRs/APYs and lending APRs; known 0% counts. Null if no positive value has an available rate. Not a portfolio APY or historical return.

includedValueUsd._note: Current principal/stake/lending value with an available applicable rate, under the category rules; zero if none.

excludedValueUsd._note: Current principal/stake/lending value excluded because its applicable rate is unavailable, under the category rules; zero if none.

byCategory._note: Breakdown by selected category using the same rate and coverage rules. One row per category, including empty categories with null rate and zero values; [] when no categories are selected.

weightedBorrowingApr._note: Current debt-USD-weighted borrowing cost, separate from positive-yield weightedApr.
weightedBorrowingApr._rule: Use current outstanding debt including accrued interest across all markets. Map credit accounts to owners; direct borrowers use their address. Include VS/protocol actors; no $1 threshold. Weight current market borrowing APRs by debt USD value; include known 0%, exclude unavailable rates and report their debt value.

apr._note: Positive annualized borrowing cost; null if no positive debt has an available rate. Never netted against weightedApr.

includedDebtUsd._note: Current debt value with an available borrowing APR; zero if none.

excludedDebtUsd._note: Current debt value excluded because its borrowing APR is unavailable; zero if none.

products._note: Select product-wide user statistics; combined counts deduplicate addresses across products and roles.

strategies._note: Filter the AMM portion of user statistics by deposit-accepting strategy type IDs; no pair filter.

_scopeRules: Token filters inherit through financial fields and market rows; token detail pages omit token-breakdown queries. Lender/borrower statistics remain product-wide. Shared ghostCredit.current configuration applies to every Ghost Credit account and does not inherit tokenIds.

Financial supply/debt/utilization/APR metrics include all participants and approved borrowers: Ghost Credit, the VS and other borrowers. No $1 threshold applies to financial metrics. Ghost Credit market-capacity fields cover Ghost Credit only.
Interest accrues. Revenue is recognized on Ghost receipt-token distributions to the Rujira/THORChain converters, not on accrual or final converter payouts.
Value revenue at distribution-time receipt redemption value and underlying-token USD price; attribute it to the underlying market token. Exclude liquidation fees.
Accrued protocol interest and distributed revenue can differ over the same range. Historical balances use historical prices; current values use current prices.
No selected markets: amounts are zero, APRs null, breakdowns/market rows empty. Unavailable data remains null.

markets(ghostCreditSupported) filters market rows only, before sorting and pagination. It does not change financial totals, charts, breakdowns or user statistics; their existing token selection still applies.

Ghost Credit borrowing is approved separately in each lending vault. The VS and other approved borrowers have their own debt limits. A Ghost Credit limit of zero, exhausted limit or zero liquidity does not remove its approval.

Current configuration/capacity is read-only. Personal collateral-based borrowing maximums and historical configuration series are outside this structure. Keep current snapshot fields separate from period totals.

TOKEN amounts are exact unscaled bank-token amounts; USD conversions use Token.price at the stated snapshot. Ghost Credit risk valuation uses its separately identified oraclePrice. Missing required data remains null, including unknown approval; known zero balances and rates remain zero.

_rules: Adjusted collateral USD = sum(collateral token amount * Ghost Credit oracle USD price * collateralRatio). Adjusted LTV = total debt oracle USD / adjusted collateral USD; this is not debt divided by unadjusted collateral value.

After borrowing or collateral changes, adjusted LTV must be strictly below adjustmentThreshold. Liquidation is permitted when adjusted LTV is at least liquidationThreshold. A zero collateralRatio contributes no borrowing power.

Example only: $100 collateral with collateralRatio 0.7 has $70 adjusted value. adjustmentThreshold 0.9 requires debt below $63; liquidationThreshold 1 reaches its threshold at $70 debt. Read current parameters instead of hardcoding these example values.
